summary: Manulife Financial Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting the pricing of a U.S. public offering of $750 million aggregate principal amount of 6.146% subordinated notes due 2041, at 100% of par. The notes are expected to qualify as Tier 2 regulatory capital and are due to issue on September 11, 2026, with a fixed-to-floating rate reset in 2036. Net proceeds will fund general corporate purposes, including potential refinancing. BofA Securities, Citigroup, J.P. Morgan, and Morgan Stanley act as joint book-running managers. This is a routine debt capital raise with no special-situation characteristics.
